with(subset(wgrtmp, .type=='original'), plot(dates,wgr, pch=as.integer(as.factor(dse))+15, col=as.integer(as.factor(dse))))

parts:
Since you didn't attach any figure or data, I really can't tell for certain what you're after, but to me it looks like you're trying to do some sort of a scatterplot with a line of predicted values.

A quick search produces this SO post with illustrative example.
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1476185/how-to-overlay-a-line-for-an-lm-object-on-a-ggplot2-scatterplot

And here's one from this mailing list that seemed to be doing what you're after.
https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!topic/ggplot2/WmGZhXkQ3Z8

Cheers,
Roman
